question: The first ________ transport aircraft was formally inducted into the Indian Air Force in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**C-295 MV**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first **C-295** transport aircraft was formally inducted into the Indian Air Force in 2023.
 
• The **C-295** is a medium-lift tactical transport aircraft jointly developed by Airbus and CASA of Spain.
 
• It was formally inducted into the Indian Air Force (IAF) on **September 25, 2023**, during a ceremony in **Vadodara, Gujarat**
 
• It can carry up to 71 troops or 50 paratroopers.
 
• The C-295 will replace the aging fleet of **Avro HS-748 aircraft** that have been in service with the IAF since the 1960s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Indian Airforce:__

__
 
• It was **established in October 1932.**
 
• **It is one of the parts of the Indian Armed force**s, the others being the Indian Army and Indian Navy.
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the IAF.
 
• The **Indian Airforce is the Fourth__ largest Airforce in the world in terms of both personnel and aircraft.**
 
• Arjan Singh was the first five-star rank-holding officer in IAF.
 
• Subroto Mukherjee was the first Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Airforce.
 
• Subroto Mukherjee is also known as the Father of the Indian Air Force.
